name: Ittai
title: The Loyal Gittite
summary: Ittai from Gath was a Philistine warrior who joined King David and showed remarkable loyalty when David fled from his son Absalom. Despite being a foreigner and newcomer, he refused to leave David in his darkest hour. He was entrusted with command of one-third of David's army in the decisive battle against Absalom's rebellion.

keyEvents.title: Ittai follows David during the flight from Absalom
keyEvents.description: When David fled Jerusalem because of Absalom's rebellion, he tried to send Ittai back, but Ittai swore loyalty and insisted on following the king no matter what awaited.

keyEvents.title: Ittai crosses the Kidron Valley with David
keyEvents.description: Ittai and all his men, including their families, crossed the Kidron Valley with David as they left Jerusalem, showing their unwavering loyalty.

keyEvents.title: Ittai is appointed commander over one-third of the army
keyEvents.description: David divided his army into three parts for the battle against Absalom and appointed Ittai from Gath to lead one third, alongside Joab and Abishai.

keyEvents.title: David's command to spare Absalom
keyEvents.description: Before the battle, David ordered his three commanders, including Ittai, to treat the young Absalom gently, demonstrating the trust David placed in Ittai.

keyEvents.title: The victory over Absalom's rebels
keyEvents.description: Ittai took part in the decisive battle in the forest of Ephraim where Absalom's forces were defeated and the rebellion crushed, securing David's return to the throne.
